∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (u : Kˣ),
  t.theta u ≠ 0 →
    CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta (t.q * u)) =
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta u) - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑t.q - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑u

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  {F : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Field F] [inst_4 : Field Ω] [inst_5 : Algebra (PowerSeries K) F]
  [inst_6 : Algebra F Ω] [inst_7 : Algebra.IsIntegral F Ω] (n : ℕ) [inst_8 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n F Ω] (u : Kˣ)
  (hu : t.theta u ≠ 0),
  (KummerTheory.kummer n F Ω) ((CoreThetaGermTransport.toFieldUnits F) (t.thetaGermUnit (t.q * u) ⋯)) =
    ((KummerTheory.kummer n F Ω)
            ((CoreThetaGermTransport.toFieldUnits F) (CoreThetaGermTransport.constantUnit (t.q * u))) *
          (KummerTheory.kummer n F Ω)
            ((CoreThetaGermTransport.toFieldUnits F) CoreThetaGermTransport.coordinateUnit))⁻¹ *
      (KummerTheory.kummer n F Ω) ((CoreThetaGermTransport.toFieldUnits F) (t.thetaGermUnit u hu))

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  {H : Type u_2} [inst_3 : CommGroup H] (φ : (PowerSeries K)ˣ →* H) (u : Kˣ) (hu : t.theta u ≠ 0),
  φ (t.thetaGermUnit (t.q * u) ⋯) =
    (φ (CoreThetaGermTransport.constantUnit (t.q * u)) * φ CoreThetaGermTransport.coordinateUnit)⁻¹ *
      φ (t.thetaGermUnit u hu)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (u : Kˣ),
  t.theta u ≠ 0 →
    (t.theta (t.q * u) • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v = t.theta u • CoreDiscreteKummer.integerRegion v ↔
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑t.q + CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑u = 0)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (u : Kˣ),
  CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta (t.q * u)) =
      CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta u) - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑t.q -
        CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑u →
    CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta (t.q * u)) = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta u) →
      ¬CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑t.q + CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑u = 0 → False

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (u : Kˣ),
  CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑t.q + CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑u = 0 →
    CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta (t.q * u)) =
        CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta u) - CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑t.q -
          CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v ↑u →
      ¬CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta (t.q * u)) = CoreDiscreteKummer.exponent v (t.theta u) → False

  [inst : NormedField K] →
    {F : Type u_2} →
      {Ω : Type u_3} →
        [inst_1 : Field F] →

                      (A : ValuationSubring Ω) →
                        (hk : ∀ (c : K), (algebraMap K Ω) c ∈ A) →

                            (hkres :
                                ∀ (c : K),
                                  (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap K Ω) c, ⋯⟩ =
                                    (algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c) →
                              [Algebra.IsIntegral F Ω] →
                                (n : ℕ) →
                                  n ≠ 0 →
                                    [KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n F Ω] →
                                      (PowerSeries K)ˣ →*
                                        ContH1 (↥(ValuationSubring.decompositionSubgroup F A))
                                          (KummerTheory.Mu n (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A))

∀ {K : Type u_3} [inst : NormedField K] {F : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Field Ω]
  [inst_3 : Algebra K F] [inst_4 : Algebra F Ω] [inst_5 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower K F Ω]
  (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (hk : ∀ (c : K), (algebraMap K Ω) c ∈ A) [inst_7 : Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)]
  (hkres : ∀ (c : K), (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap K Ω) c, ⋯⟩ = (algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c)
  (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (σ : ↥(ValuationSubring.decompositionSubgroup F A)) (ζ : KummerTheory.Mu n Ω),
  (KummerTheory.Decomposition.reduceMu A n hn) ((ValuationSubring.decompositionSubgroup F A).subtype σ • ζ) =
    σ • (KummerTheory.Decomposition.reduceMu A n hn) ζ

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] {F : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Field Ω]
  [inst_3 : Algebra K F] [inst_4 : Algebra (PowerSeries K) F] [inst_5 : Algebra F Ω] [inst_6 : Algebra K Ω]
  [inst_7 : IsScalarTower K F Ω] (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (hk : ∀ (c : K), (algebraMap K Ω) c ∈ A)
  [inst_8 : Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)]
  (hkres : ∀ (c : K), (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap K Ω) c, ⋯⟩ = (algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c)
  [inst_9 : Algebra.IsIntegral F Ω] [inst_10 : Algebra.IsIntegral K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
  [inst_11 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n F Ω],
  (∀ (s : PowerSeries K), (algebraMap F Ω) ((algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) s) ∈ A) →
    ∀ [inst_12 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)],
      (∀ (c : K), (algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) (PowerSeries.C c) = (algebraMap K F) c) →
        ∀ (a : Kˣ),
          (CoreThetaGermTransport.reducedGermHom A hk hkres n hn) (CoreThetaGermTransport.constantUnit a) =
            (ContH1.map (KummerTheory.Decomposition.decompositionMap F A hk hkres) ⋯
                (MonoidHom.id (KummerTheory.Mu n (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A))) ⋯ ⋯)
              ((KummerTheory.kummer n K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) a)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] {F : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Field Ω]
  [inst_3 : Algebra K F] [inst_4 : Algebra (PowerSeries K) F] [inst_5 : Algebra F Ω] [inst_6 : Algebra K Ω]
  [inst_7 : IsScalarTower K F Ω] (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (hk : ∀ (c : K), (algebraMap K Ω) c ∈ A)
  [inst_8 : Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)]
  (hkres : ∀ (c : K), (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap K Ω) c, ⋯⟩ = (algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c)
  [inst_9 : Algebra.IsIntegral F Ω] [Algebra.IsIntegral K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
  [inst_11 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n F Ω]
  (hA : ∀ (s : PowerSeries K), (algebraMap F Ω) ((algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) s) ∈ A),
  (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap F Ω) ((algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) PowerSeries.X), ⋯⟩ = 0 →
    ∀ [KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)],
      (CoreThetaGermTransport.reducedGermHom A hk hkres n hn) CoreThetaGermTransport.coordinateUnit = 1

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
  {F : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Field F] [inst_4 : Field Ω] [inst_5 : Algebra K F]
  [inst_6 : Algebra (PowerSeries K) F] [inst_7 : Algebra F Ω] [inst_8 : Algebra K Ω] [inst_9 : IsScalarTower K F Ω]
  (A : ValuationSubring Ω) (hk : ∀ (c : K), (algebraMap K Ω) c ∈ A) [inst_10 : Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)]
  (hkres : ∀ (c : K), (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap K Ω) c, ⋯⟩ = (algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) c)
  [inst_11 : Algebra.IsIntegral F Ω] [inst_12 : Algebra.IsIntegral K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
  [inst_13 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n F Ω]
  (hA : ∀ (s : PowerSeries K), (algebraMap F Ω) ((algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) s) ∈ A),
  (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨(algebraMap F Ω) ((algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) PowerSeries.X), ⋯⟩ = 0 →
    ∀ [inst_14 : KummerTheory.HasKummerRoots n K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)],
      (∀ (c : K), (algebraMap (PowerSeries K) F) (PowerSeries.C c) = (algebraMap K F) c) →
        ∀ (u : Kˣ) (hu : t.theta u ≠ 0),
          (CoreThetaGermTransport.reducedGermHom A hk hkres n hn) (t.thetaGermUnit (t.q * u) ⋯) =
            ((ContH1.map (KummerTheory.Decomposition.decompositionMap F A hk hkres) ⋯
                    (MonoidHom.id (KummerTheory.Mu n (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A))) ⋯ ⋯)
                  ((KummerTheory.kummer n K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A)) (t.q * u)))⁻¹ *
              (CoreThetaGermTransport.reducedGermHom A hk hkres n hn) (t.thetaGermUnit u hu)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (t : TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter K)
